definitions.gloss: both armies; both sides; both teams
definitions.explanation: Both of two opposing armies, or in sports reporting both of two competing teams.

examples.japanese: {両軍|りょうぐん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激突|げきとつ}→激突：13416_gekitotsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{両軍|りょうぐん}{無得点|むとくてん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧まま⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んだ→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: The game went on with neither team scoring.

examples.japanese: {関|せき}ヶ{原|はら}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{戦|たたか}い→戦い：02070_tatakai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{東西|とうざい}→東西：04554_touzai⟧{両軍|りょうぐん}⟦{合|あ}わせて→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧{十数万|じゅうすうまん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{兵|へい}→兵：29510_hei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われる→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: At the Battle of Sekigahara, the eastern and western armies together are said to have numbered well over a hundred thousand soldiers.

notes:
Used in history and war reporting, and in sports writing, especially baseball.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {両軍|りょうぐん}{無得点|むとくてん}: neither team has scored
- ⟦{東西|とうざい}→東西：04554_touzai⟧{両軍|りょうぐん}: the eastern and western armies (or teams)
- {両軍|りょうぐん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{兵力|へいりょく}→兵力：22001_heiryoku⟧: the strength of both armies

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{両|りょう}→両：11182_ryou⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧: both teams; the everyday word in sports
- {両陣営|りょうじんえい}: both camps (in politics or a dispute)
